features.name: funding_purpose
features.description: What the money is mainly for: manufacturing a product for backers; creating a creative work (book, comic, game, film, album, art); opening, running or saving a business or venue; a charitable or community cause; organising an event; or other.

features.name: has_concrete_deliverable
features.description: True if the text makes clear that backers will receive a specific thing (a copy, a product, a reward); false if it only asks for support.

features.name: project_stage
features.description: How far along the project appears to be according to the text.

features.name: appeal_type
features.description: Whether the text sells something to backers (offer) or asks for help for the creator (plea).

features.name: specificity
features.description: How concrete the description is: 1 = vague slogan, 5 = precise what, how and for whom.

features.name: language
features.description: Main language of the title and description.
